summary: Frontend-only verification of the split Theme/Experiences filter model on Singapore + Thailand (desktop 1920) and Thailand (mobile 390), plus Egypt legacy URL preselect, Thailand honeymoons variant, and detail-page regressions. All 7 review scenarios pass end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: filterModel.js is well-contained (~158 lines); THEME_RULES + HONEYMOON_RULES + EXPERIENCES stay data-driven. No hardcoded per-country configs — good.
ThemeChips.jsx MAX=10 and dim behaviour on 0-count chips is correct; shown chips preserve a selected chip beyond cap (ok).
HolidayFilterPanel ExperienceOptions PREVIEW=8 with Show all / Show fewer toggle works and keeps selected ones visible when collapsed.
Mobile sheet correctly deep-links to the Experiences tab via initialGroup='experience' when the Experiences pill is tapped.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Singapore /asien/singapore/holidays: All(22). Desktop strip label='Experiences' with chips: Cable car rides(18), Night Safari(14), Singapore Zoo & River Wonders(14), Gardens by the Bay(13), Wings of Time show(12), Universal Studios(11), Marina Bay Sands SkyPark(10), S.E.A. Aquarium(8), Jewel Changi(6), Singapore Flyer(6). Sidebar sections (order): Theme, Experiences, Destination, Duration, Price range. Theme rows (16, no 'Grand tour'): Honeymoon(10), Family(14), Short trips(13), Luxury(3), Nature & wildlife(18), Theme parks(15), City break(9), Shopping(8), Food & markets(7), Adventure(6), Nightlife & party(6), Cruise holidays(5), Multi-city tours(4), Culture & temples(3), Beach(2), Island hopping(1). Add Theme Family -> theme=Family&experience=Universal+Studios, count=9 (AND across groups). Active chips eg-filter-chip-theme 'Theme: Family' and eg-filter-chip-experience 'Experiences: Universal Studios' present. Island hopping -> count=13, cards=13, H1='Thailand island hopping holidays'. Legacy /afrika/aegypten/holidays/nile-cruise -> eg-filter-chip-experience='Experiences: Nile cruise', count=7. /asien/thailand/honeymoons -> romantic theme labels (Private & secluded, Beach romance, Island escapes, Luxury stays, Multi-city journeys, City & nightlife, Culture & temples, Cruises & sunsets, Adventure for two, Short & sweet) + Experiences strip visible. Mobile 390 Thailand: pills order Filters·Theme·Experiences·Destination·Duration·Price range. Tap eg-mobile-group-experience -> sheet opens on Experiences tab with 8 options + 'Show all 39 experiences'. Tick Phi Phi -> apply='Show 12 holidays'. Switch to mobile-filter-group-theme + tick Family -> apply='Show 6 holidays'. After apply URL=?theme=Family&experience=Phi+Phi+Islands, eg-mobile-result-count='6 holidays'. Detail pages render with 0 broken images and 0 console errors: /asien/singapore-family-holiday-with-universal-studios, /afrika/aegypten/luxor-strand-urlaub, /asien/north-central-vietnam-highlights-6d5n. Note: there is no explicit 'eg-clear-all' or 'Clear all' testid in the active-chip row on desktop — individual eg-filter-chip-{group} x-buttons remove each selection; a 'Clear all' link appears in the sidebar panel header when any filter is active. Not a blocker.
